Example Data for OSL Bayesian Age Model

Source: R/Jingbian.R
OSLJingbian.Rd

Example Data for OSL Bayesian Age Model

Usage

OSLJingbian

Format

A list with 7 elements :

ThetaMatrix

The Theta Matrix Covariance for dose rate errors

D

Equivalent doses

sD

Equivalent doses errors

Nb_sample

Jingbian OSL sample size

SampleNames

Jingbian OSL sample names

Output

Jingbian OSL Unconstrained Bayesian Output

References

Stevens, T., Buylaert, J.-P., Thiel, C., U ́jv ́ari, G., Yi, S., Murray, A. S., Frechen, M., and Lu, H. Ice-volume-force d erosion of the chinese loess plateau global quaternary stratotype site. 9(1):983. Publisher: Nature Publishing Group
